Your privacy is our top priority. Our application does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data, media files, or metadata to external servers. All operations are performed locally on your device. We do not have access to your personal chats, contacts, or WhatsApp account details.

Unlike traditional apps, we do not request broad access to your device\'s internal storage or media gallery. This app utilizes the Android Storage Access Framework (SAF), which allows you to grant permission only to the specific WhatsApp status directory. This ensures that the app cannot view or modify any other files or folders on your device.

To function correctly, the app only requires: 

 • Folder Access: User-granted permission via the system file picker to read status media from the official WhatsApp directory. 
 • Notifications (Optional): Used solely to notify you about new statuses or expiring media. 

 We do not require "Read External Storage" or "Media Access" permissions for the entire device.

All media files retrieved from the permitted folder are processed in a secure, offline environment. Since no data is uploaded to the cloud, your media remains private and under your absolute control at all times.

We do not use third-party tracking or analytics tools. While standard Google Play Services may provide basic crash logs for app stability, no personal media or usage patterns are shared with any third party.
The app is intended for a general audience and does not knowingly collect data from children under 13. We comply with all applicable privacy regulations regarding minor protection.
This policy may be updated to reflect changes in Android OS requirements. The latest version is always accessible within the app settings.

Navigate to:\nAndroid > media > com.whatsapp > WhatsApp > Media > .Statuses
If you don\'t see \'Android/media\', look directly for:\nWhatsApp > Media > .Statuses
Look for:\nAndroid > media > com.whatsapp.w4b > WhatsApp Business > Media > .Statuses
Step 4: Folder is Missing or Hidden?
Click the (⋮) menu in the top right and tap \'Show Hidden Files\'. Without this, you cannot see the \'.Statuses\' folder.
First, open WhatsApp and watch some statuses. If you haven\'t viewed any status in the last 24 hours, the folder will appear empty.
Search for a folder named \'Dual\' or \'999\' or \'Parallel\' in your main storage root.
Important: After selecting the folder, tap \'USE THIS FOLDER\' and then \'ALLOW\'.
